blocks.text: 这是一则震惊全球的辞职消息。英伟达联合创始人、执掌公司33年的深陷困境的CEO黄仁勋已正式卸任。一位neocloud创始人向TechCrunch回忆起初闻此事时的感受：“就像炸弹爆炸了一样。”

blocks.text: 过去几年，英伟达一直是活跃的投资者，每年向初创企业投入数百亿美元。据PitchBook数据，仅今年它就参与了105轮融资，且往往担任最大投资方。“如果这个方向发生变化，对许多年轻公司将是沉重打击，”Relational Capital创始人Maria Davidson表示。

blocks.text: 投资者称，黄仁勋的离开让初创生态失去了最大的支持者之一，短期内资本也将大幅减少，这可能对交易撮合、估值、融资乃至竞争格局产生巨大影响。

blocks.text: It was the resignation heard across the world. Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s embattled CEO who co-founded and led the company for 33 years, had officially stepped down. “It’s like a bomb went off,” one neocloud founder told TechCrunch when he first heard the news.

blocks.text: Over the last several years, Nvidia has been a prolific investor, pouring tens of billions into startups annually, and participating in 105 rounds this year alone often as the largest investor, according to PitchBook. “If that direction changes, it’ll be a big blow to so many young companies,” said Maria Davidson, founder of Relational Capital.

blocks.text: Huang’s absence leaves the startup ecosystem without one of its biggest champions and with far less capital for now, investors say, which could have a massive impact on dealmaking, valuations, funding, and even competition.

blocks.text: “Nvidia is carrying almost every AI-native startup from application to neocloud,” Dawn Capital’s Shamilla Bankiya told TechCrunch.

blocks.text: Most of the significant decisions to invest in startups often came from Jensen himself, according to Umesh Padval, managing partner at Seligman Ventures. Padval has known Huang since serving on the board of Mellanox Technologies, a networking chipmaker Nvidia acquired for approximately $7 billion in 2020. While there is hope that Huang’s eventual successor will resume his dealmaking spree, investors aren’t hopeful that it will happen in the short term.

blocks.text: For instance, Nvidia backed CoreWeave back when it was still private, and participated in two of Crusoe’ rounds, including its $1.4 billion Series E.
